messages:
Alex: ok handing off to @Maria for the afternoon. Quick recap from the postmortem follow-up — three remediation items still in flight: 1) autoscaler edge-case patch, 2) canary rollback verification, 3) alert noise filter for mem spike alerts.
Maria: got it. I can take ownership of 2 + 3. Alex, can you drop the exact PR/commit for the autoscaler patch so I can refer? :eyes:
Alex: PR is https://git.redwood/infra/auto-scale/pulls/345 — commit 9f3b2d8. Note: we kept the canary at 10% yesterday while running load tests.
Kevin: I merged the autoscaler fix to staging last night. Staging deploy looked fine, but we didn't run the full long-run warmup. I'll schedule a 2h soak today and report back.
Sara: FYI I ran quick smoke after the staging merge. No obvious OOMs, but consumer lag spiked in one region for ~3m. Logs attached to the PR.
Jordan: for the canary rollback verification (item 2), I can re-run the controlled failover tomorrow AM and confirm the fallback path triggers. Want me to coordinate with ops for a quiet window?
Maria: yes please coordinate. Plan: Jordan -> do the failover test 09:30 PT, Kevin -> ensure the autoscaler soak finishes by 09:00 PT, Sara -> run the pre/post smoke and paste results here. If all green we close items 1+2.
Alex: also important — the postmortem flagged a discrepancy in alert thresholds between regions. I put a quick registry note in the incident ticket: ALERT-REG-42. Maria, can you confirm the alert filter rule (#alerts/filter-42) is what you planned to deploy?
Maria: checking now. The filter rule branch is alerts/filter-42. It will suppress transient mem spikes under 30s and require 2 consecutive violations. That should cut the noise without hiding real regressions.
Kevin: running the soak. Command I used: ```kubectl -n inference get hpa -o wide ; kubectl -n inference logs deploy/autoscaler -f --since=2h``` will paste logs after soak.
Sara: pre-check done. Baseline p95 latency: 180ms, error rate 0.12%. After the quick test post-merge p95 went to 185ms, error rate unchanged. I uploaded traces to /runs/17945/soak1.
Maria: thanks. Jordan — when you schedule the rollback test, please call out the exact window here and tag ops. I'll be online. Also I'll run the alert rule dry-run against the last 48h to confirm no unintended silences.
Jordan: scheduling 09:30-09:50 PT with ops, tagging @ops. Will post runbook steps.
Alex: one more note — if the canary rollback reveals autoscaler mismatch again, we should consider temporarily increasing concurrency limits for the affected replica set. Documented in the postmortem as mitigation C.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 09:30 PT (canary test) — ops on-call: @ops. See #maintenance for details. :bell:
Maria: final ask — if anyone sees the mem spike alerts reappear after 09:50 PT, ping me directly and we'll reopen the postmortem tracking card. Otherwise I'll update the ticket and mark items 2+3 as verified by EOD. :thumbsup:
Kevin: will update here after soak by 08:50 PT.
Sara: will post smoke outputs after Jordan's test.
Alex: thanks all. handing off to Maria — I'm reachable if anything blocks. :coffee:
